scope: Frozen-profile uniform-mixture Y06 scenarios; no production rate change and no calibrated upper bound for H/He.
source: Yakovlev et al. (2006), PRC 74,035803, equations12,33,36–39 and TableII; https://arxiv.org/abs/astro-ph/0608488
checks: Native screening masks, baryonic composition moments and nodal mass weights.
Affected-cell count and rounded fuel ceiling agree with production history.
Printed TableII and literal equation38 temperature parameters change total power by at most2.090e-5 fractionally.
limitations: Frozen T profiles: no re-equilibrated star, no fuel transport or depletion.
Y06 uniform-mixture extrapolation is not calibrated for trace protons in helium. Models are not rigorous bounds.
Selected SFIII S(0), with generous downstream Q. No energy-dependent S(E) or additional reaction channels.
Native fixed-pattern GS98 ion/electron moments and actual CN reaction abundances match the production approximation.
At a projected fuel-rich refusal the selected production nuclear provider would stop.
